name: hermes_cli_doctor_render_state_db_stats
notes: state.db stats renderer (doctor_helpers.c vs LIVE hermes_cli/doctor.py). The C port covers only the two info-line ladders; LIVE's FTS-table rung and oversize-warn rungs are excluded by input choice (small sizes, no fts_tables key). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE (excluded from inputs): holders=0 — LIVE appends a '0 process(es)' row bit and renders a second info line, while the C port requires holders>0 and stays silent; the water-cup correctly flags this as a real port gap worth fixing. Line TEXT also diverges (C raw byte counts vs LIVE _human_bytes + thousands separators), so only line KINDS are hashed.
